_about: Every file the pipeline writes or reads. Hand-kept; tests/test_technical_guide.py checks it against the code and docs/make_technical_tables.py turns it into the guide's file tables.

files.what: One row per CZI file: what the header says about the scan. Read by every stage that needs a file's channels, pixel size or clip ceiling.

columns.name: source
columns.meaning: Where the file was found: the source folder or a zip.

columns.name: container
columns.meaning: The zip that holds it, or empty for a loose file.

columns.name: animal
columns.meaning: The animal id parsed from the file name.

columns.name: slide
columns.meaning: The slide id parsed from the file name.

columns.name: variant
columns.meaning: Which scan of the slide, when it was scanned more than once (`a`, `b`, ...); empty for one scan.

columns.name: name_suffix
columns.meaning: Anything after the recognised parts of the file name.

columns.name: marker_channel
columns.meaning: The marker's dye as the file names it (for example AF568).

columns.name: acquired
columns.meaning: Acquisition date and time from the header.

columns.name: size_s
columns.meaning: Number of scenes the header declares.

columns.name: n_scenes
columns.meaning: Number of scenes found in the metadata.

columns.name: pixel_type
columns.meaning: The container type, for example Gray16.

columns.name: component_bit_count
columns.meaning: Bits the sensor fills, from ComponentBitCount (16 on the LS study).

columns.name: clip_ceiling
columns.meaning: The highest value a pixel can hold, 2^bits - 1; every clipping test reads this.

columns.name: channel_pixel_types
columns.meaning: Each channel's pixel type, joined with `|`.

columns.name: shading_reference_mode
columns.meaning: The scanner's own shading correction setting.

columns.name: online_stitching
columns.meaning: Whether the scanner stitched tiles while scanning.

columns.name: is_redundant_copy
columns.meaning: 1 for a second copy of a file already seen (same name in another zip).
